title: The localized comparison square for the characterized map
statement: Let R,A,B,Aq,D be commutative rings with compatible R-algebra structures and maps A -> Aq, A tensor_R B -> D and Aq tensor_R B -> D as in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let Q be an A-module cochain complex, L a base-derived tensor cohomology model of Q tensor-derived_R B, and K such a model of (Aq tensor_A Q) tensor-derived_R B. Let i be an integer. Define u_Q on the underlying R-complex by x |-> 1 tensor x. Let zeta:L.derived -> K.derived be the unique counit-compatible derived-functor isomorphism. Define c_(L,K) as (L.cohomologyIso i).hom followed by H^i(L.derived(u_Q)), H^i(zeta at Aq tensor_A Q), and (K.cohomologyIso i).inv. A D-linear morphism e is characterized when e(1 tensor x)=1 tensor c_(L,K)(x) for every x. Assume the coefficient maps to D are compatible with common maps from A, B and Aq, including A -> Aq -> D. For any characterized D-linear isomorphism e, and any termwise isomorphism tau from D tensor_A Q to D tensor_Aq (Aq tensor_A Q) sending d tensor x to d tensor (1 tensor x), the equality L.localizedComparison(i);H^i(tau)=e;K.localizedComparison(i) holds. No localization hypothesis is required for this compatibility statement.

proof.text: Use firstLocalization_ordinary_square to obtain the additive ordinary cohomology square before extension to D.

Prove the coefficient-complex square termwise. Represent every input by L.ordinaryIso.hom using its degreewise surjectivity and induct on tensors b tensor x. Cancel L.ordinaryIso.inv, substitute both ordinaryIso_tmul and ordinaryToLocalized_tmul and the formula for tau. Both coefficients equal algebraMap B D b by tBD and tBqD. Zero and sum cases follow additivity.

Apply scalarExtension_homology_square with the ordinary cohomology square, the coefficient-complex square, both localized_eq identities and the generator equation he. This gives the required D-linear comparison square.

theorem firstLocalization_comparison (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D)
    (e : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (L.cohomology i) ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (K.cohomology i))
    (he : IsFirstLocalizationMap R A Aq B D Q L K i e.hom)
    (τ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ≅
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap Aq (Aq ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
                ((extend A Aq).obj Q))
    (hτ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X j),
            τ.hom.f j (d ⊗ₜ[A,(algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) =
              d ⊗ₜ[Aq,(algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D).comp
                (algebraMap Aq (Aq ⊗[R] B))] ((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq] x)) :
          L.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i =
            e.hom ≫ K.localizedComparison i
